headline: TRITN jumps 50.00% on a price gap, leading the most active moves in the CONs sector today
market_take: The CONs sector saw the strongest activity with TRITN up 50.00% on a price gap, SQ rallying 17.65% intraday and DEMCO slipping 6.35% intraday. PROP stocks were mixed, led by STELLA (+13.04%) and EVER (+12.50%) gains while KUN fell 11.43% and RML dropped 9.09%. FOOD showed solid upside in F&D (+18.75%) and TFG (+12.82%) but CHOTI declined 7.64% despite a volume spike. Unusual‑trading alerts often coincided with recent filings, notably TPOLY’s intraday rise after a high‑priority trading‑sign filing and BJCHI’s price gap following a SP sign posting.
